search_window.basis: Start at completed_at of the latest verified prior Food Line Source Watch heartbeat on ops/watch-ledger; searches used October 27–28 freshness overlap, with older and duplicate items excluded.

coverage_notes: Bounded supplementary Food Line high-value recall only. The nationwide production collector remains authoritative; this watch does not approve, publish, post to social media, change scheduling, or disable itself.

Executed 12 targeted web searches, three each for: only/sole/last/full-service community grocery loss, disaster-related emergency food distribution cancellation, abrupt pantry/food-bank service closure or major access cut, and newly official SNAP/WIC/EBT interruption with immediate food-access consequences. Freshness emphasis October 27–28 2026, America/Los_Angeles.

No newly qualifying and independently verified U.S. food-access disruption was found between October 28 08:45:45 and this completion time Pacific. Older and duplicate incidents, non-disruption distribution schedules, 2025 federal-shutdown SNAP news, and ongoing policy coverage were excluded. Lack of findings in this bounded watch does not establish nationwide absence.

Kauaʻi Now October 27 Hurricane Lowell recovery notice lists emergency food distributions for October 27 and October 30, rather than a cancellation; excluded: https://kauainownews.com/2026/10/27/what-kaua%CA%BBi-county-residents-visitors-need-to-know-thursday-about-hurricane-lowell-recovery/

An attempt to open the Massachusetts Department of Transitional Assistance directory https://www.mass.gov/orgs/department-of-transitional-assistance returned HTTP 403. Its indexed material concerned older notices and routine information, not a newly confirmed benefit interruption. The isolated failure was recorded as DEGRADED rather than aborting remaining usable coverage.

Web search results contained unrelated older disaster closures, non-U.S. storm news, October 2025 SNAP interruption reports and general agency directories. No candidate met the requested source, time and immediate-impact tests.
Search index delays and inaccessible social/provider notices are inherent limitations. No direct authority to change the authoritative production pipeline was used.
